lines.text: Amos warns those at ease in Zion, and sends them to Calneh, Hamath and Gath to ask if they are better.
They lie on ivory beds, dine on lambs and calves, and improvise songs on the harp like Abraham.
They drink wine by the bowlful and fail to grieve over Joseph's ruin, so they will go into exile first.
The LORD abhors Jacob's pride and will deliver up the city, and the great house will be smashed to pieces while the small house is spared.

wrong_details.true: the small house will be rubble

lines.text: They turned justice into poison and boasted of taking Karnaim, so the LORD will raise up a nation to oppress them.
